'''Emil Kerseage''' was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the shuttle that brought [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] to [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao]]. After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] the transport company Kerseage had owned had been run out of business by a poorly worded regulation the [[Prackla Trade Council]] had issued. Kerseage's company was gone, and he blamed Lord [[Pilester Binalie]] for it. [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] used his case as on official cover for his mission to Cartao.
